meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 将文章、笔记或主题等文字变成一部解说视频:不拍摄、不抓网页,而是按每一场内容原创画面(排版、图表、图形、数据可视化);随后规划故事板与脚本、选配旁白和音乐,逐帧成图并渲染出 MP4。
howto.when: 当用户给出文章/笔记/主题并要它做成“讲解、教程或清单类”解说视频,而不是给某个网站/产品做宣传或导览时触发;拿不准会先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成一部无人出镜的解说视频。
say.note: 会先给出故事板供确认,再继续做画面。

say.text: 用男声做一段60秒讲“复利”的科普短视频。
say.note: 会指定男性音色而非沿用默认音色。

say.text: 先把分镜和旁白拿给我看,我确认后再渲染出片。
say.note: 这一步会停在确认关,等你批准才继续。

howto.what_en: Turns arbitrary text into a faceless explainer video, inventing every visual per scene (typography, graphics, diagrams). No site or footage is captured. Outputs: storyboard/script, optional audio, HTML frames, and MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user supplies text (an article, notes, or a topic) and asks for an explainer, tutorial, or listicle video — not a promo/tour of a website/product. If unclear, it routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It pauses to show the storyboard for approval.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second faceless explainer about compound interest with a male voice.
say_en.note: It assigns a male voice id instead of the default.

say_en.text: Show me the storyboard and script first; I will approve before you animate.
say_en.note: It stops at the storyboard gate until you approve.
